title: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment…
The air in the garden feels heavier now… quieter…

Then I hear it—
“Where are you?”
I watch Adam freeze. Not because he doesn’t hear… but because he does. The voice isn’t harsh. It’s searching. It’s personal. It’s near.
And suddenly I realize—this question was never just for him.
It reaches across time… into my own hiding places. Into the spaces where I pretend I’m fine. Into the parts of me that avoid being seen.

Not to expose.
But to restore.

So I pause in this moment and ask myself—
If He called my name right now… would I step out from behind the leaves?
🔥 If God asked you that today, what would you say?
